act_skip_spans_two_turns.needs: the first NextSession skip, one turn in, spans at least two turns

ask_town_hall_and_another_offered.needs: a town-hall ask and one other are offered within the first four turns (small world)

councillor_and_regular_at_a_place.needs: a non-player councillor, and a regular whose own place is one in the town

executive_post_open_to_file_for.needs: the town's executive post is open, not held by the player, and fileable

explorer_enacts_own_law.needs: a small world where the explorer legislator's own bill is enacted within 72 months

flood_arc_exits_idle_by_month_12.needs: a planted flood raises the arc, still running at month 3, and the idle game lets it exit by month 12

fresh_colleague_and_bill_before_council.needs: a council colleague with no edge to the player, and a bill before the council

introduction_ask_offered_early.needs: an ask.introduce_me is offered within the first four turns (small world)

law_lapses_in_first_skip.needs: the first NextSession skip lists a lapsed law, with its policy named

notebook_talk_reply_has_an_outcome.needs: the first key figure answers topic.who_runs with a spoken reply

plant_closure_crisis_starts_clean.needs: a town with an industry and no closure crisis at the start, one after a shock and none three years on

player_race_for_the_executive_within_30_.needs: a medium world where filing for the executive office puts the player in its race within 30 turns

promises_reachable_by_skipping.needs: a small world where the campaign promise picker opens within six rounds of skips

regional_capital_medium.needs: a medium world whose player's town has a regional assembly

town_with_a_factory.needs: the player's town has a factory (small world)

voices_close_unequally.needs: a chamber where the smooth and plain voices each close, and smooth closes more often
